items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 2: Oregon ducks onto list
items.description: Strange happenings continue in college football, where long losing streaks have become a winning formula.

items.headline: Missouri State ground game churns out 48-14 win over FCS-member Lindenwood
items.description: — Ramone Green Jr. ran for two touchdowns and Missouri State recorded six rushing touchdowns in a 48-14 win over FCS-member Lindenwood on Saturday.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 1: UMass turns it upside down
items.description: The Minutemen showed there's hope for us all with a shocking win over Rutgers.

items.headline: Marcel Reed sparks No. 8 Texas A&M in a 50-0 rout of Missouri State
items.description: — Marcel Reed threw for 233 yards and two touchdowns in just over three quarters to help No. 8 Texas A&M roll to a 50-0 win over Missouri State on Saturday night.

items.headline: Highlight: No. 8 Texas A&M shuts out Missouri State
items.description: The Aggies spread the wealth on offense with six different players scoring a touchdown as the defense dominates and posts five TFL in the 50-0 win.
